'''Paul Todd Feldman EBO With A Twist''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Paul Todd Feldman]], published on [[Torch Industries]].<ref name="torch">[http://members.aol.com/drtorch/EBO.html Paul Todd Feldman's EBO with a twist!], Torch Industries (Paul Todd Feldman). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20000303121000/http://members.aol.com:80/drtorch/EBO.html Internet Archive]</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Paul Todd Feldman]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Special Edition]] (from the card pool)
* '''Published:''' [[Torch Industries]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room)|Hoth-L-hothechocommandcenterwarroom.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Echo Base Operations
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Feldman LS EBO Twist Torch.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==
Feldman's [[Echo Base Operations]] deck adds [[Never Tell Me The Odds]] and fast, cheap droids. He wrote that EBO should be running within five turns. He listed Space/3,720 To 1 decks as its weakness.<ref name="torch" />
